data.title: 胡桃 · 海灯盛典回眸
data.description: 【胡桃 · 海灯盛典回眸】海灯节万众欢腾的璃月海港观景平台上，数以万计的璀璨霄灯升入夜空。胡桃换上了华美的春风汉服罗裙，在漫天绚烂烟花绽放的瞬间欢快回眸，广袖轻扬，笑容比夜空中的花火还要灿烂夺目——「海灯节快乐！新的一年，也要记得常来往生堂坐坐哦～」
data.location: 璃月港海灯节观景平台
data.action: 身着华丽汉服在璀璨霄灯海中欢快回眸，广袖轻扬，背景漫天烟花绚烂
data.lighting: 万千金色霄灯泛光与夜空烟花多色炫彩
data.promptProse: Hu Tao turns back joyfully on the Lantern Rite terrace, a flowing sleeve lifting from her crimson-and-black butterfly-embroidered hanfu. Her jade hairpin and plum ornament sit above the familiar bright eyes. Frame her from the knees upward at a low angle, with the terrace rail crossing below ascending Xiao Lanterns. Their gold light warms her sleeve; bursting fireworks shift colored highlights across her hair above the dark harbor.
